outgoing.name: Coal
outgoing.excerpt: This element is found in argyrodite ( sulfide of germanium and silver); coal; germanite; zinc ores; and other minerals.

outgoing.name: Diamond
outgoing.excerpt: Germanium is a hard, grayish-white element that has a metallic luster and the same crystal structure as diamond.

outgoing.name: Microscope
outgoing.excerpt: Its oxide's index of refraction and dispersion properties make germanium useful in wide-angle camera lenses and in microscope objective lenses.

outgoing.name: United States dollar
outgoing.excerpt: In 1998 the cost of germanium was about US$3 per gram.
